tagline: PdfCraft on a Selkies web desktop, for reading, editing, signing and running OCR on PDFs in the browser.
description: PdfCraft, a PDF reader and editor with forms, annotations and OCR, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: PdfCraft
